body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Monster showcased its new high-performance in-ear headphones 'Turbine In-Ear Speakers' at CES 2009, which delivers impeccable audiophile-quality sound.

Monster Turbine In-Ear Speakers feature 8mm drivers precision-engineered for superb sonic detail that delivers the big sound, deep bass, and clarity that you'd expect from full size high-end speakers.

Monster's advanced cable technologies also enable Turbines to deliver superior performance. Patented Magnetic FluxTube delivers more accurate audio, while MicroStrand conductors ensure maximum cable flexibility and better signal transfer.
Monster Turbine In-Ear Speakers are available for a suggested retail price of $149.95 per pair.
